content: sherpa-onnx runs on ONNX Runtime and already has native NPU acceleration paths (QNN, NNAPI, XNNPACK, CoreML) without needing ONNX->TFLite conversion. MediaTek Genio Community confirms ONNX Runtime NeuronExecutionProvider is the official EP for MDLA NPU on Genio, built into Yocto since PR4. No documented direct sherpa-onnx SenseVoice ONNX->TFLite conversion path found; TFLite conversion is a MediaTek-specific detour that adds conversion-failure risk vs using onnxruntime NeuronExecutionProvider directly.
